function: Learned compensation of combined transceiver hardware imperfections (quantization, IQ imbalance, phase noise, phase-shifter error, PA nonlinearity), a predistortion-type function outside the seven areas; pp. 2, 6-8.
notes: Excluded for function (borderline). The NNs learn a per-RF-chain symbol-level compensator of DAC/ADC quantization, IQ imbalance, phase noise, phase-shifter error and PA nonlinearity (pp. 6-8), minimizing MSE/SER (p. 6). Its learned baseline D-DNN [30] is a neural digital predistortion (p. 2, pp. 11-12), i.e. amplifier linearization, not beam or precoder design: the analog and digital precoders, combiners and H are taken as known (p. 10) and the paper never says how they are designed. The paper does call the output a digital precoder or combiner (pp. 2, 8), so the reviewer may prefer area 3. If so: q1=0 (channel only written as H, no model named, pp. 3, 10), q2=0 (retrained for each transmit power, p. 11), q3=1 (uncompensated system and D-DNN on SER, pp. 11-12), q4=1 (parameter counts and runtime, Tables II-III, pp. 12-13), q5=0 (no code or data link). The PDF is the arXiv version 2411.14699v1 of the work, read as preprint.
